stats.Effect: Greater Dye of STR <Str+1 Con-1> Collect and take 10 units of this type of magical dye to the symbol maker in town and you will receive a symbol that boosts your abilities tattooed onto your body. Can be used by all classes after completion of their second class transfer, and can be kept and used after the completion of the third class transfer as well.
